flows.title: Open Notes, start a note
flows.tagline: One flick: Notes opens and a blank note is ready to type in.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Opens the Notes app.
Waits 0.6 seconds so it can come up.
Presses Cmd+N for a new note.
flows.notes: A macOS shortcut (Cmd+N). On another system, record the shortcut again in the Flow editor.

flows.title: Copy, switch window, paste
flows.tagline: Carry the selection to the other window in one gesture.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Presses Cmd+C to copy what is selected.
Waits, then presses Cmd+Tab to switch to the other app.
Waits, then presses Cmd+V to paste.
flows.notes: Written with macOS shortcuts. On Windows or Linux change "mods": 8 to "mods": 2 in the Flow editor, or record the keys again.

flows.title: Ask how many, ping that many times
flows.tagline: A tiny loop that shows how questions, variables and While blocks fit together.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Asks you a number (3 is pre-filled).
Counts up with a While block.
Shows one notification per round, then a final one.
flows.notes: On Linux it needs notify-send for the notifications, and zenity or kdialog for the question.

flows.title: A form panel, then say the answer
flows.tagline: Text, slider and switch in one small window. Copy it and make it yours.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Shows a panel with a text box, a slider and a switch.
Reads what you entered into variables.
Tells you the answer in a notification.
flows.notes: Needs "Let flows show panels" (on by default).

flows.title: Five rounds with a progress panel
flows.tagline: See a bar fill while a flow works, with a Stop button.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Opens a progress panel.
Runs five rounds of pretend work, moving the bar each time.
Closes the panel when done.
flows.notes: Needs "Let flows show panels" (on by default).

flows.title: Jump to the tab that has a word
flows.tagline: Type a word, land on the tab whose title or address has it.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Asks for a word.
Asks the browser extension to go to the tab that matches.
Says so when there is none.
flows.notes: Needs the CursorPie Bridge browser extension.

flows.title: Pause the music only if it plays
flows.tagline: No more accidental play: it pauses what plays and says so when nothing does.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Asks the extension what the players in your browser are doing.
If something plays, pauses it.
Otherwise shows "Nothing is playing".
flows.notes: Needs the CursorPie Bridge browser extension.

flows.title: Browser remote that stays open
flows.tagline: A little remote for your tabs and players. It stays up while you click.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Opens a panel with play, skip and tab buttons.
Each press runs a browser command and the panel stays on screen.
Closes with Cancel or when you are done.
flows.notes: Needs the CursorPie Bridge browser extension and "Let flows show panels".

flows.title: Send a saved reply on Telegram or WhatsApp
flows.tagline: Pick a saved reply, pick a chat, confirm, sent.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Lists your saved replies (set in the extension's options).
Asks which reply and which chat (empty means the open chat).
Asks you to confirm, then sends it.
flows.notes: Sends a real message after you confirm. Needs the CursorPie Bridge extension with "Allow sending messages" on.

flows.title: Open a page, wait, log the time
flows.tagline: A starter for chaining a link, a pause and a shell command.
flows.author: sebastvnd
steps: Opens https://example.com.
Waits one second.
Appends the date to ~/cursorpie-flow.log with a shell command.
flows.notes: The command is POSIX shell, so it works on macOS and Linux.
